# Diffuse

> Local-first Apple apps that answer one question: what changed on this device between two points in time?

Diffuse is not a cloud product. Four genuinely native apps — macOS, iOS, iPadOS, watchOS — share a capability-driven domain engine. Snapshots never leave the device. There is no account, no telemetry, and no third-party Swift packages.

- Site: https://hoangsonww.github.io/Diffuse/
- Source: https://github.com/hoangsonww/Diffuse
- License: MIT
